title: Unit 27 Consolidation: Healthcare in Hungary, 2010–2026
grammar: Review: comparison, cause, time frames, open questions and concession
goal: I can summarise the pay agreement of 2020, the hospital debts and the nurses' pay between 2010 and 2026, with years and sources.
I can compare, link cause and result, frame time, report open questions and concede in a neutral account.
I can report the Medical Chamber law of 2023, the Healthy Budapest Programme and the 2026 election with dates.
